name: Night Stay
summary: A hotel stay date range picker where each night you book lights a window in the lodge above
about: A check-in and check-out picker for a hill lodge. Every day shows its nightly price, booked-out days are struck through, and as you sweep towards a check-out date a band flows across the calendar with a live nights-and-price bubble while lodge windows light up one per night. It checks the minimum and longest stay, refuses stays across full nights, shows the moon phase on your arrival night and slides out a room key card when you reserve.
how: Pick a check-in day, then move to a check-out day: the band, the bubble and the lit windows preview the stay
Stays must be 2 to 14 nights and cannot cross a fully booked night; the day shakes and the message explains why
Use the arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down to move between days and months, Enter to pick, Escape to clear
Set the number of guests, check the total with tax, then press Reserve to get the room key card
